notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42230734/e1b28f986b1aa5521227b3c4e4ef14e2009049c9.png[/img]

notes.title: Chernobyl: Origins - Developer diaries
notes.notes:
In the developer diaries, the guys from Nelset share their experience in developing the Chernobyl: Origins project. You can see how the work on the soundtrack is going and see how the guys listen to their community to make the project better.

[previewyoutube=meAgo2YWNYk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your support, the team works exclusively for you!

notes.title: "STEAM SCREAM" and new DEMO!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42230734/578476bf8a6d260a1b40a1b65d3981421de9aea6.png[/img]
Hello, friends!
Specially for the "STEAM SCREAM FESTIVAL", our team has prepared a new "DEMO" of Chernobyl: Origins. In the new demo, you can see how the horror component of our game manifests itself. We look forward to your feedback. Remember, the best support is to add the game to your wishlist. Good game!
